name: jojopas-plugins
description: Reusable Claude Code skills by jojopas.

plugins.name: war-gaming-plans
plugins.description: Stress-test an implementation plan before you build it — verify every assumption, sweep failure scenarios, fold fixes back into the plan.

plugins.name: agent-persona
plugins.description: Bring a persistent, file-backed agent teammate into a Claude Code session in Become, Consult, or Delegate mode. Works with OpenClaw or any agent-workspace layout via roster.json.

plugins.name: session-baton
plugins.description: Bank a session into a one-shot, self-deleting resume marker so the next session resumes with zero ramp-up. Ships the /renew skill plus a SessionStart hook that auto-injects the marker on /clear.
